rows.Kwic: 進云：「和尚不妨著眼。」師云：「老僧分疏不下。」

Override.AttributionNote: 林野奇禪師語錄, exchange with Pomeng. Linye Tongqi is the exact speaker of the stored answer: after Pomeng tells him to apply his eye, Linye says that this old monk cannot explain it away.

rows.Kwic: 進云：「畢竟如何趨向？」師云：「動念即乖。」進云：「不動念時如何？」師云：「眉毛在眼上。」

Override.AttributionNote: 林野奇禪師語錄, public exchange with a nun studying Zhaozhou's dog case. Linye Tongqi is the exact speaker of the stored answer: when she asks how ultimately to proceed, he says that stirring a thought immediately goes astray.
